name: kaio-base
description: Kaioken base monorepo: offline symbol oracle, provenance-tracked wiki, and deterministic truth layer packages

scripts.build:kaioken: tsc --build kaioken/index kaioken/modelport kaioken/plan kaioken/wiki kaioken/research kaioken/skillgen kaioken/evals kaioken/completion kaioken/gitops kaioken/graph kaioken/impact kaioken/provenance kaioken/scan kaioken/search kaioken/serve kaioken/skills kaioken/verify kaioken/verifycore
scripts.check:kaioken: tsc -p tsconfig.kaioken.json && node scripts/check-kaioken-offline.mjs && node scripts/check-kaioken-barrels.mjs
scripts.pack:kaioken: npm run build:kaioken && node scripts/build-kaioken-pi.mjs && node scripts/check-kaioken-pi-package.mjs
